objective: Independent unblinded saved-scalar/grid reconstruction for the six declared historical DSS runs; no model/native/producer execution.

resources.cpu_reservation: one worker plus inherited supervisor; no concurrent reservation assumed without coordinator check
resources.as_scope: hard address-space bound; RSS is measured at stated observation points, not a separate hard RSS promise
resources.output_scope: Worker Sink accounts for all eleven science outputs including final report and manifest. Supervisor separately samples the combined attempt including captured source/logs and may stop earlier; small forensic failure.json is preserved outside Sink accounting.

coordinator_metadata_io.measurement_scope: Archive/member/hash/header/axis/progress-index preparation; source Git reads and final manifest hashing excluded from byte counter. Not target arithmetic runtime.

resources.original_control_failure: A bad-index fixture reassigned [0,0] to its existing value. The original run exited1 only for that control; full six-shape calculation/serialization and other controls completed. Original bytes retained.
resources.forecast_scope: Measurements are manufactured, not an upper-bound proof. Pair extrapolation treats the oscillatory core rate as planning evidence only and excludes some driver metadata/serialization cost. Fixed CPU120/wall180/1GiB/256MiB bounds dominate; any limit failure is retained without silent retry.

coverage.masks: Exact equivalence names and all distinct filtered counts/witnesses retained; base-ok geometry reused, zoom not-complex multiplier geometry separate.
coverage.source_progress: All original BFS indices and seed records. Failed/unvisited initialized NPZ payloads and possible later progress tails remain distinct.
coverage.overlaps: Exact coordinate pairs plus separately labelled fixed-ordinal lo/hi-to-original scalar comparisons. No tolerant matching.
coverage.four_sector: All quad sign-pair counts and same-quad witness support. Cross-quad/boundary four-sector support unresolved; no new crossing pass.
coverage.spacing: Actual per-axis spacing/extrema and coarse-to-zoom ratios, not a universal five-times refinement.
coverage.gap_claim: No exact original distance definition/source; quoted1.3e-3 not independently verified.

provenance_scope: Own selected target/metadata/source bytes hashed before/after. Nested historical receipt/archive/termination authority is inherited from coordinator authentication; no fresh Git/pod/native check. Durable outer inputs is byte-identical; nested/tmp paths unchanged.
scientific_limits: Original native orbit/eigenvectors/parent signs/closing dots/Ritz residuals not saved.
No proof of exact intersection, unsampled absence, full-spectrum nonzero eigenvalues or global dimension.
Method and token-cohort amendments were made after producer outcomes; exposure disclosed.
